salt-grain.name: klayout-magic-pcells
salt-grain.title: PCells generated by Magic for sky130A, gf180mcuD and the IHP PDKs
salt-grain.doc: KLayout PCells drawn by Magic, one library per PDK: sky130_magic (sky130A), gf180mcu_magic (gf180mcuD), sg13g2_magic (ihp-sg13g2) and sg13cmos5l_magic (ihp-sg13cmos5l). There is a PCell for each device generator in the PDK's Magic code and for each of its via, contact, substrate-contact, guard-ring and well generators. A device PCell stores the values that Magic's parameter dialog shows for what you type, has Magic draw the device from them and copies Magic's GDS, so the geometry is that of the cell Magic's dialog creates. Needs Magic and at least one of the PDKs.
